name: Sivers Semiconductors AB (publ)
blurb: Sivers Semiconductors AB develops, manufactures, and sells chips, components, modules, and subsystems based on semiconductor technology. It operates through Wireless and Photonics segments, providing products for 5G mmWave networks, fiber networks, wireless optical networks, and sensors. The company serves customers in North America, Europe, and Asia, and has a market cap of approximately 12.86 billion SEK. Founded in 1951 and headquartered in Sweden, it employs around 130 people.
recent: In the past 30 days, SIVE stock has experienced significant volatility, with a 52-week range of 2.85 to 59.10 SEK. The stock price as of May 11, 2026, was 42.62 SEK, down 2.07% on the day. The company is scheduled to report earnings on May 15, 2026, which may be a near-term catalyst.
